STATUS AND SHAPE: pass on the fake backend, evidence contract_checked. The package serves the ACT joint-space insertion scene assets/bimanual_viperx_insertion.xml as a MujocoDriver in simulated mode R0 (cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1), reading the model in place from the read-only clone at 742c753c0d4a5d87076c8f69e5628c79a8cc5488; neither the model nor its assets are copied. MODEL CHOICE: the card lists four scene models; models[0] is the end-effector insertion scene. This package serves models[2] because the MujocoDriver bridge writes data.ctrl only, while the end-effector scenes have just the four finger actuators and move the arms through mocap bodies (ee_sim_env.py:63-74; assets/bimanual_viperx_ee_insertion.xml:45-50); the joint-space scene has a position actuator for every arm joint and finger (assets/bimanual_viperx_insertion.xml:27-44), which the bridge drives. NOT COVERED: the upstream task layer (the 14-value joint+gripper action and its two-finger expansion, START_ARM_POSE/BOX_POSE initialisation, reward, camera images and the 20 s time limit; sim_env.py:23-26, :58-71, :180-183, :48); MuJoCo physics (not installed and not installable where the gate runs; no network, no pip); the fake backend is a pure Python stand-in for the mujoco module that reads the include-expanded MJCF for the actuator control ranges and joint dimensions but integrates a placeholder first-order motion, loads no STL mesh and resolves no contact, equality or tendon constraint; no trajectory was compared with the real engine; no physical ViperX or ALOHA robot is modelled and no hardware run is claimed. The fake's integration step is the MuJoCo library default 0.002 s, marked placeholder in fake.py, because the model sets no active <option timestep> (assets/scene.xml:2 is commented out); the published fidelity timestep_ms 2.0 is therefore a property of the stand-in, not a model fact. WARNINGS (expected; no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY): G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because the fake backend is the package's stand-in mujoco module supplied as a class object (the form the SDK's own MuJoCo family tests use; the fake is not the upstream simulator); G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the family-derived inputs seed, action.ctrl and ticks (PLAYBOOK.md section 8 expected for simulator families). The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware backend exists for this simulated R0 driver and no hardware was attached.
